 int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_range_min = 0

Specifies the minimum range value from where the Pre-begin symbols are corrupted. Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be smaller or equal to pre_begin_error_range_max. Default value is 0.

 int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_range_max = 1

Specifies the maximum range value up to which the Pre-begin symbols are corrupted. Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be greater or equal to pre_begin_error_range_min. Default value is 1.

 bit [2:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_value = 0

Specifies the Pre-begin symbol error value.
  • error_kind == RAND_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, random corrupted(excluding 3) value will be transmitted.
  • error_kind == USER_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, pre_begin_error_value value will be transmitted.
  • Default value is 0.

Specifies mask for Pre-end 7 symbol value. Respective bit value [6:0] indicates which Pre-end symbol will be corrupted.

  • pre_end_error_mask_value[0] = 0 : Indicates Pre-end symbol zero will not be corrupted by pre_end_error_value[0].

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::post_error_value = 0

Specifies the Post symbol error value.

  • error_kind == USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between post_error_range_min and post_error_range_max range, post_error_value value will be transmitted.

 int  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::num_invalid_entry_state_error_values = 0

Random variable to specify the size of invalid_entry_state_error_values[]. Its value should be confined within [1 : SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_ENTRY_STATE_ERROR_VALUE_MAX (10)].
  • Default is 0.

 bit [2:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::invalid_entry_state_error_values[]

Random/User specific HS/ESC entry state error values, considered only when error_kind is INVALID_VALUE_IN_HS_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR. or INVALID_VALUE_IN_ESC_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR. User need to populate the array with valid/invalid HS/ESC entry states values.

  • If user wishes to insert erroneous value LP-101, after Escape Go state, this array should contain values {3'b100, 3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b000, 3'b101}.
  • If user wishes to insert multiple erroneous value LP-101, LP-010, LP-110 etc. after LP-YIELD state, this array should contain values {3'b100, 3'b000, 3'b101, 3'b010, 3'b110}
  • If user wishes to insert erroneous value LP-010 followed by LP-111 after HS-Request state, this array should contain values {3'b001, 3'b010, 3'b111}
  • Note: User should specify LP-111 as last element of this array, because after sending all these array element values model will transmit the correct HS/ESC entry values. On reception of LP-111, the receiver resets itself and wait for fresh request.

 bit [7:1]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::drop_lpdt_bit = 7'b1111_111

Bit vector value is only considered when error kind is DROP_BITS_IN_ESC_LPDT_BYTE_ERROR. Respective bit element value will indicate whether that bit will be dropped in respective LPDT byte transmission or not.
  • drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 1 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will be dropped.
  • drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 0 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will not be dropped.
  • Same way other bits value of drop_lpdt_bit will be consider to drop or not drop the respective bits in LPDT byte.
  • Note: LPDT byte Bit 0 is excluded from dropping, because internal model has dependency on this.
  • Default is 7'b1111_111.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::lane_error_enable = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'hF

Specifies lane error enable value. Respective bit value [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):0] indicates which lane error injection is enabled.
  • lane_error_enable [0] = 1 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is enabled.
  • lane_error_enable [0] = 0 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is not enabled.
  • Note: Same definition should be considered for lane_error_enable[(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):1] values. Also lane_error_enable value should be non-zero.
  • Default value is 4'hF, all lane error injection is enabled.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::ppi_error_insertion_for_complete_transaction = 0

Specifies whether to keep PPI error insertion for complete transaction or not.
  • 1 : Keep PPI error insertion for complete transaction starting from 'ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min/max' value
  • 0 : PPI error insertion duration will be inbetween 'ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min/max' and 'ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_min/max' value. Not for complete transaction.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [20:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::t3_post_error_value[]

Specifies the errorneous value to be driven during T3-Post length when error kind is USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR or RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR The values specified in the array will be transmitted in place of T3-Post symbols 21 bits represents 7 symbols in t3-post. MSB [20:18] - will be transmitted first and LSB [2:0] - will be transmissted last Value greater than or equal to 4 in each symbol will be sent as 4.
